The '''EW-94 Miniprobe''' was a type of small [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] that was available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The EW-94 Miniprobe appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a pet that could be acquired from the Seneschal's Stronghold Pack.
